```{=html}
<style>
.fl-hidden { display: none; }
.fl-cp { border-left: 4px solid #4c6ef5; background: #f5f7ff; border-radius: 6px;
         padding: 0.8em 1em; margin: 1.1em 0; }
.fl-cp.pass  { border-left-color: #2f9e44; background: #f2fbf4; }
.fl-cp.shown { border-left-color: #868e96; background: #f8f9fa; }
.fl-cp-prompt { font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.55em; }
.fl-cp-row { display: flex; gap: 0.55em; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.fl-cp input[type=text] { width: 9em; padding: 0.32em 0.55em; border: 1px solid #adb5bd;
         border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--bs-font-monospace, monospace); }
.fl-cp button { padding: 0.32em 0.95em; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #4c6ef5;
         background: #4c6ef5; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.92em; }
.fl-cp button:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }
.fl-cp button.fl-showme { background: #fff; color: #495057; border-color: #adb5bd; }
.fl-cp-units { color: #495057; }
.fl-cp-fb { margin-top: 0.5em; font-size: 0.95em; }
.fl-cp-fb.ok { color: #2b8a3e; font-weight: 600; }
.fl-cp-fb.no { color: #e67700; }
.fl-cp-hint { margin-top: 0.45em; color: #7048e8; font-size: 0.95em; }
.fl-cp-sol  { margin-top: 0.45em; color: #495057; font-style: italic; }
.fl-reveal-all button { padding: 0.3em 0.9em; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.85em;
         border: 1px solid #adb5bd; background: #fff; color: #495057; cursor: pointer; }
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  function parseNum(s) {
    s = (s || '').replace(/[,\s]/g, '').replace('\u2212', '-');
    var v = parseFloat(s);
    return isNaN(v) ? null : v;
  }
  function reveal(id) {
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.classList.remove('fl-hidden');
  }
  function initCheckpoint(el) {
    var ans = parseFloat(el.dataset.answer);
    var tol = parseFloat(el.dataset.tol || '0.02');
    var target = el.dataset.target || '';
    var hint = el.dataset.hint || '';
    var sol = el.dataset.solution || '';
    var units = el.dataset.units || '';
    var okText = el.dataset.okText || '✓ correct — next step unlocked below.';
    var attempts = 0;
    el.classList.add('fl-cp');
    el.innerHTML =
      '<div class="fl-cp-prompt">\u270B Checkpoint \u2014 ' + el.dataset.prompt + '</div>' +
      '<div class="fl-cp-row">' +
      '  <input type="text" inputmode="decimal" aria-label="your answer" placeholder="your number">' +
      '  <span class="fl-cp-units">' + units + '</span>' +
      '  <button class="fl-check" type="button">Check</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="fl-cp-fb" aria-live="polite"></div>' +
      '<div class="fl-cp-hint fl-hidden">\uD83D\uDCA1 ' + hint + '</div>' +
      '<div class="fl-cp-sol fl-hidden">' + sol + '</div>';
    var input = el.querySelector('input');
    var fb = el.querySelector('.fl-cp-fb');
    var hintEl = el.querySelector('.fl-cp-hint');
    var solEl = el.querySelector('.fl-cp-sol');
    var btn = el.querySelector('.fl-check');
    var row = el.querySelector('.fl-cp-row');
    function pass(shown) {
      el.classList.add(shown ? 'shown' : 'pass');
      fb.className = 'fl-cp-fb ok';
      fb.textContent = shown
        ? '\u2014 shown, no penalty. Read the step below, then try the next prediction yourself.'
        : okText;
      input.disabled = true; btn.disabled = true;
      var sm = el.querySelector('.fl-showme');
      if (sm) sm.remove();
      if (shown && sol) solEl.classList.remove('fl-hidden');
      if (target) reveal(target);
    }
    function check() {
      var v = parseNum(input.value);
      if (v === null) {
        fb.className = 'fl-cp-fb no';
        fb.textContent = 'Enter a number (units shown at right).';
        return;
      }
      var ok = Math.abs(v - ans) <= Math.max(tol * Math.abs(ans), 1e-9);
      if (ok) { pass(false); return; }
      attempts += 1;
      fb.className = 'fl-cp-fb no';
      fb.textContent = (attempts === 1)
        ? 'Not quite \u2014 see hint below.'
        : 'Still off \u2014 check units and signs, or take the reveal. No penalty either way.';
      if (hint) hintEl.classList.remove('fl-hidden');
      if (attempts >= 2 && !el.querySelector('.fl-showme')) {
        var sm = document.createElement('button');
        sm.type = 'button';
        sm.className = 'fl-showme';
        sm.textContent = 'Show me';
        sm.addEventListener('click', function () { pass(true); });
        row.appendChild(sm);
      }
    }
    btn.addEventListener('click', check);
    input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') check(); });
  }
  function revealEverything() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.fl-hidden').forEach(function (d) { d.classList.remove('fl-hidden'); });
    document.querySelectorAll('div.fl-checkpoint input, div.fl-checkpoint button')
      .forEach(function (x) { x.disabled = true; });
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    document.querySelectorAll('div.fl-checkpoint').forEach(initCheckpoint);
    document.querySelectorAll('div.fl-reveal-all').forEach(function (d) {
      var b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button';
      b.textContent = 'Reveal everything (skip the checkpoints)';
      b.addEventListener('click', revealEverything);
      d.appendChild(b);
    });
    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', revealEverything);
  });
})();
</script>
```
